reviews.title: Needs updating
reviews.text: I just got the new iPhone 18 Pro, and I can no longer search because the search icon is way up above near where the battery and Wi-Fi icon is, so please can you update the app

reviews.title: Not as useful as it used to be.
reviews.text:
This app used to be great. 

Now it hardly ever updates when my packages are moving. 

It also seems to have an issue with USPS tracking as it will always say not found and will use a third party site for tracking so the updates are delayed which defeats the purpose of the app as I can just get accurate real time tracking from USPS itself.

reviews.title: Very delayed updates
reviews.text: The tracking a lot of the times are 10 + days delayed, whereas other apps will have the current destination/status of package.

reviews.title: No longer updates
reviews.text: I loved this app when I first installed it.  Now it no longer seems to be updating and is not accurate at all.  The status will stay the same for days, and the information is totally different when you track it on the postal service site.  Unless it gets fixed, I don’t plan to renew.

reviews.title: Suddenly stopped working
reviews.text:
Such a shame! I loved this app when it worked and used it for many years. You simply entered the tracking number and it knew where your package was. I could have many packages at a time all in one convenient place.
Now it won’t even update. Packages that arrived weeks ago won’t show up as delivered. I have to go to the USPS website to get any useful information.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text:
I’ve tried logging out logging back in still shows Amazon packages not delivered. Before the packages were showing en route and they already arrived at the facility really slow to update information. This app needs an update soon.

Running an iPhone 14 Pro Max iOS 26.1

Don’t get this junk

reviews.title: Can’t Trust It
reviews.text: The app takes so long to display tracking updates that you simply cannot trust it. I received a package today that the app still thinks is in a different state. Tracking on the USPS website is fully accurate and says the package was delivered while detailing every stop it made. This app hasn’t updated the tracking in 2 days and thinks the package is still in the next state over. No matter how many times I force the app to reload, the tracking will not update. This app cannot be relied upon for important tracking updates.

reviews.title: XXX-rated porno advertisers
reviews.text: The app has worked really well until you notice the X-rated photos in the advertising area… porn has no place in a business app

reviews.title: Reasonable at best
reviews.text: Easy to use and seems to detect carrier but it’s usually at least a day behind or worse, which kind of defeats the whole point. Usually end up installing carriers own apps for accurate info. So like so many others this app is ok for a list of outstanding items but not really much good for accurate all in one place real time tracking.
